messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Oh, hey!{01 00 00 0f 00} That's quite
neighborly of you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}So then, what time should
I come over?
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Oh, hei!{01 00 00 0f 00} See on sinust
päris naabrilik,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Nii et mis kell ma
tulema peaksin?

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}{07 16 00}Hey, look, it doesn't
need to happen right away
or anything.
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}What time works for you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Oi!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}{07 16 00}Kuule, see ei pea
juhtuma kohe
või midagi.
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Mis kellaaeg sulle sobib,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh yeah!{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm real flattered
that you'd invite me over,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Well then, about when should
I show up?

{07 03 00}I bet you need a few weeks
to clean up your place,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh jaa!{01 00 00 0f 00} Väga meelitav,
et sa mind kutsud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Noh siis, millal ma
umbes kohale ilmun?

{07 03 00}Vean kihla, et sul kulub
paar nädalat koristamiseks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
